tasks.short: Assist with screening or placement in adapted physical education.

steps.what: Review the actual referral, existing support information and approved screening procedure
Assist in the actual physical screening, explain activities and capture actual student performance and needs
Interpret the actual screening findings and contribute a professional recommendation to the responsible placement team
Write and check actual screening and recommendation record v1 using existing student identifiers
Save the exact checked actual screening record v1 in the same restricted student record

tasks.design: Configure native referral/procedure links and existing identifier reuse in the student support-record system {OTHER}. Actual screening, interpretation and placement-team discussion remain human, with the complete actual note checked before its separate save; no placement decision is automated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Referral context and approved procedures may require separate searches and note headers repeated entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native linked records can reduce those specific navigation and entry operations.
tasks.still_hard: Observed movement and individual support needs require skilled personal assessment.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise what actual student performance means and communicate uncertainty to the placement team.
tasks.altitude: Less context lookup and header entry; screening duties and rights stay the same.

reach.learn: Distinguish observed screening facts from recommendations and final decisions.

evidence.claim: Native support-record links and identifiers can reduce preparation without evaluating or placing students.

assumptions: Boundary is the specialist's assistance and actual screening record. The authorised team's final placement decision and status change remain separate unchanged work. Shares are provisional, not measured.

Referrer and responsible staff produce actual student id, referral question and current approved support information; procedure owner provides method/version. Specialist manually produces actual observations and recommendation in s2/s3. Missing context is obtained manually; planned ability or diagnostic labels are not invented.

Native configuration first. The 10% note reduction is repeated identifiers only; screening, interpretation and substantive note checks retain full effort. Same-system save earns no saving. Allocate any repeated assessment once across tasks.
unknowns: Actual support-record permissions and placement process
research_questions: Can native links remove context navigation without exposing unnecessary support information?

already_counted.description: Actual screening note, recommendation and final check.

incremental.description: Maintain procedure links and nonclinical identifier mapping.

approvals.approved_version: checked actual screening record v1; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Native context links remove 3 preparation hours and headers remove 1.9 record hours per provisional 100 task hours less 0.5 upkeep. An already configured record gives no gross return; actual screening and placement contribution remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain confidential attendance, participation and progress records.

steps.what: Capture and verify actual student attendance, participation and observed progress after the activity
Enter actual attendance and participation against the correct student and session with explicit absent, present and unknown states
Organise prior actual records and calculate specified attendance and participation totals for the review period
inputs: defined review period and count rules

steps.what: Write actual progress observations without inferring a diagnosis or unobserved ability
Check the complete actual student record v1, source facts and correct confidential record location before saving
Save the exact checked confidential student record v1 in the same restricted record

tasks.design: Configure native session-linked forms and count reports in the student support-record system {OTHER}, retaining restricted access. Actual observation and status selection stay human; identifier reuse and specified totals reduce repeated entry and assembly, while progress prose and final confidentiality checks remain human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Session headers and attendance totals can be re-entered or recounted despite existing records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native session forms and fixed count queries can reuse identifiers and actual entered states.
tasks.still_hard: Thorough actual observations and appropriate confidentiality require the specialist.
tasks.human_edge: Record what the student actually did and recognise sensitive or misleading wording.
tasks.altitude: Less record assembly with the same observation and confidentiality responsibility.

reach.learn: Use actual session facts and avoid duplicating confidential observations.

evidence.claim: Native pupil-record tools support records and goal tracking; installation-specific session reuse and queries need checking.

assumptions: Boundary is general ongoing attendance, participation and progress records. Screening records and separately assessed progress notes costed elsewhere must be allocated once, not rewritten and counted again. Shares are provisional.

Specialist captures actual student id, session id/date, attendance state, actual participation and actual observations after the session in s1. Timetable produces only session identifiers, never actual attendance. Missing facts stay unknown pending manual clarification. Report owner supplies review period and counting rules.

Try native forms and reports first. Only identifier/session repetition and fixed totals shrink; actual capture and progress meaning remain full. Do not introduce public sharing or default all scheduled students to present. Same-system save earns no saving.
unknowns: Current native session forms and query capability
research_questions: Can native forms remove repeated headers and count assembly while keeping actual statuses explicit?

already_counted.description: Check actual totals and missing-status handling.
Final actual-record accuracy and confidentiality check.

incremental.description: Maintain session-field and count definitions after record changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked confidential student record v1 and correct restricted location; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A native linked form removes 5 repeated-header hours and count queries remove 10 assembly hours per provisional 100 task hours less 1 upkeep. Existing native use offers less repetition; actual capture, progress prose and privacy checks stay full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare lessons consistent with individual education plans and students' functional needs.

steps.what: Review the actual individual education plan and current verified functional needs and restrictions relevant to this lesson
Choose appropriate lesson objectives, activities, equipment adaptations and supervision within the student's actual needs
Write the lesson plan from the specialist's selected activities and actual individual constraints

loop.purpose: Draft clear lesson instructions around activities chosen by the specialist.
loop.input: Selected objectives, exact activities, adaptations, supervision and verified constraints.
loop.output: Lesson plan draft with explicit links to supplied objectives and restrictions.
loop.check: Specialist checks instruction meaning, activity sequence, adaptations, supervision and fidelity to actual restrictions; no new exercise prescription or inferred ability is accepted.
loop.stop: One draft and correction; missing safety or activity decisions return to manual authorship.
loop.why_not_simpler: Native headings alone do not phrase the selected sequence into clear teaching instructions.

steps.what: Check the completed adapted lesson plan v1 against the individual plan, actual needs, chosen adaptations and available supervision
Save the exact checked adapted lesson plan v1 in the same restricted lesson-preparation folder

tasks.design: Use a native {DOCS} lesson template first, then a bounded instruction draft from activities and adaptations already selected by the specialist. Keep all functional-needs interpretation and activity selection human, and check the completed plan against the current individual plan in {OTHER} before its separate save.
tasks.previous_blocker: Selected individual adaptations must be written into clear lesson instructions.
tasks.enabler_now: A constrained draft can phrase an explicit teaching sequence without selecting the activities.
tasks.still_hard: Actual student needs, safe adaptations and day-of-lesson readiness require professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Choose an activity that is appropriate for this student's current abilities and support.

ambition.what: No new placement or clinical rights.

tasks.altitude: Less plan prose drafting, with the same individual instruction decisions.

reach.learn: Map selected activities to actual individual objectives without changing support decisions.

evidence.claim: A source-constrained loop can draft teaching instructions around specialist-selected activities, subject to substantive review.

assumptions: Boundary is lesson-plan preparation, not delivering the lesson or changing the individual education plan. Shares are provisional.

The responsible team supplies the current individual plan and authorised restrictions; the specialist supplies current verified needs, exact objectives, activities, adaptations, supervision and available equipment. Missing facts or safe activity decisions require manual resolution before drafting; no pupil diagnosis or ability is inferred.

Native templates first. Use only authorised necessary pupil data; consultation/access work is included in rollout. The model does not evaluate learning outcomes. Same-system save and all needs/selection judgement keep full effort.
unknowns: Permission for confidential support information in the drafting environment
Actual prose-writing effort after activities are selected
research_questions: Does the reviewed draft preserve individual adaptations without adding unsafe or unrequested activities?

already_counted.description: Check generated teaching instructions against actual selected activities and restrictions.

incremental.description: Maintain drafting constraints and approved source access after support-plan changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked adapted lesson plan v1 and restricted preparation location; changes void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: With explicit specialist-selected activities, a checked draft removes 10.5 of the provisional 30 prose hours less 1 upkeep. Novel adaptations leave less reusable wording; needs review, activity decisions, final check and save remain full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Assess students' physical progress or needs.

steps.what: Retrieve and check actual prior physical progress observations and current individual objectives
Observe actual student movement and participation and conduct appropriate personal assessment activities
Interpret the actual observations and determine physical educational needs or progress within professional scope
outputs: actual physical needs and progress assessment

steps.what: Write and check the actual physical progress/needs assessment note v1, distinguishing observation from interpretation
inputs: actual physical needs and progress assessment
outputs: checked actual physical assessment note v1

steps.what: Save the exact checked actual physical assessment note v1 in the same restricted student record
inputs: checked actual physical assessment note v1
outputs: saved actual physical assessment note v1

tasks.design: Configure a native chronological observation view in the student support-record system {OTHER}, retaining source dates and missing-data flags. The specialist still observes actual physical performance, interprets needs and writes/checks the real assessment note before its separate save; no automatic assessment or student ranking is added.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior observations and current objectives can require several record lookups.
tasks.enabler_now: Native timeline and objective links can reduce reference navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Actual needs and progress depend on context, support and observed performance.
tasks.human_edge: Understand the student's actual movement and distinguish a difficult day from a meaningful change.

ambition.what: No new diagnostic or educational placement rights.

tasks.altitude: Less history navigation; all personal assessment remains.

reach.learn: Preserve actual observation context and avoid treating an absent measure as failure.

evidence.claim: Native observation timelines can reduce record navigation without interpreting student performance.

assumptions: Boundary is actual physical assessment and its specific note, not general attendance maintenance or lesson delivery. Shared observations/notes across tasks must be allocated once in a roll-up. Shares are provisional.

The specialist and responsible staff produce dated actual observation records with student id, activity, support/context and observed performance; the support team maintains current objectives. New actual observations are manually captured in s2/s4. Missing history is obtained manually or marked unknown, not inferred from a timetable.
Try native timeline configuration first. No observation, interpretation, note-writing, review or same-save reduction is claimed. Data access and school consultation needs are included in rollout.
research_questions: Does a native timeline reduce retrieval without making incomparable activities appear equivalent?

already_counted.description: Actual assessment note authorship and final meaning check.

incremental.description: Maintain timeline and objective links after record changes.

approvals.approved_version: checked actual physical assessment note v1; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: A native observation timeline removes 3 of the provisional 10 history-navigation hours less 0.5 upkeep. An already unified timeline gives no gross saving; personal observation, interpretation and actual assessment notes retain full effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Less repeated reference and record preparation while individual assessment and adapted teaching choices remain human.
reach: Provide traceable actual observations to the student support team.
role.ambitious_version: An adapted physical education specialist with clearer checked preparation and unchanged student assessment authority.
